verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships its own agents (SRE Agent, Scribe, Shift, Insights), so acting as an MCP client is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence only documents PagerDuty's official MCP server, which lets external AI clients reach PagerDuty. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about. The SRE Agent's first-party connectors (GitHub, Sentry) and Skills are adjacent features. None of them show users plugging arbitrary MCP servers into PagerDuty so its agents can use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
